items.name: The Infinite Loop Lasagna
items.description: Layer upon layer upon layer... It never ends. Beef ragu, ricotta, and mozzarella baked until golden.

items.name: Stack Overflow Burger
items.description: Too much of a good thing. Double smash patties, American cheese, pickles, caramelised onions, and our secret sauce on a brioche bun.

items.name: Recursive Ribs
items.description: A function that calls itself until it falls off the bone. Slow-smoked pork ribs glazed in bourbon BBQ sauce.

items.name: Merge Conflict Mac & Cheese
items.description: Two competing flavours that somehow work together. Smoked gouda, cheddar, truffle oil, and crispy breadcrumb topping.

items.name: sudo salmon
items.description: You don't need permission to enjoy this. Pan-seared Atlantic salmon, lemon dill butter, roasted asparagus, and herbed rice.

items.name: Binary Onion Rings
items.description: On or off, 0 or 1. Thick-cut onion rings in a craft beer batter with chipotle aioli.

items.name: Git Chips & Guac
items.description: Commit to the dip. House-made tortilla chips with fresh smashed avocado, lime, and jalapeno.

items.name: The Try-Catch Tacos
items.description: Even if something goes wrong, we've got you covered. Three soft-shell tacos with choice of pulled pork, chicken, or grilled veggies.

items.name: The Sudo Smoothie
items.description: It does what you tell it to. Mango, passionfruit, banana, and coconut milk blended to perfection.

items.name: Segfault Espresso
items.description: A core dump of flavour. Double-shot espresso pulled from single-origin beans.

items.name: The Null Pointer
items.description: Points to nothing but refreshment. Sparkling water with fresh mint, lime, and a hint of elderflower.

items.name: Hot Chocolate.js
items.description: A warm, comforting runtime for your taste buds. Belgian chocolate, steamed milk, whipped cream, and marshmallows.

items.name: 404 Sundae Not Found
items.description: This page doesn't exist, but this sundae definitely does. Three scoops of gelato, hot fudge, caramel, whipped cream, and a cherry.

items.name: Hello World Cake
items.description: Everyone starts somewhere. Moist red velvet layer cake with cream cheese frosting. Your first bite, your first love.

items.name: The Bit Shift Brownie
items.description: A left shift of chocolate intensity. Dense fudge brownie with walnuts, served warm with vanilla bean ice cream.

items.name: The API Antipasto
items.description: An interface to Italian flavour. Cured meats, marinated olives, roasted peppers, aged parmesan, and focaccia.
